modifications: Repacked into per-system GLBs, stable IDs/metadata added. Draco geometry bytes and image bytes unchanged. Original geometry, UVs, normals, material values and global coordinate positions preserved. No generated anatomy or procedural anatomical textures.

coordinates.sourceToApp: Identity; original GLB positions and hierarchy retained. All source nodes have no matrix/TRS transforms.
coordinates.orientationEvidence: Source right-sided limb models lie at negative X; superior Y follows full skeleton height 1.705 m; sternum/pubis are anterior (+Z) to scapula/sacrum. Shared bone bounds across source regions agree at submillimetre scale, documented separately.

limitations: Original regional selection models, predominantly right-sided; missing contralateral geometry is not inferred or generated. Each region retains its native global coordinates.
The hand selection overlaps the upper-limb selection; counts across regions are asset counts, not unique anatomical entities.
Named overlays and landmarks are educational surface representations, not always separately dissectible tissues. Explicit overlays are tagged and hidden by default.
Some regional vessels, nerves, muscles or bones are truncated at model boundaries. Source names do not imply complete anatomy.
The pelvis/perineum selection is male. It must not replace the separate HRA female pelvis.

Model source table is CC BY-SA 4.0; separately distributed UBC-derived muscle textures are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Their exact embedded-image lineage is not enumerated per file by the source, so preserve both notices and restrict this textured package to noncommercial educational reuse unless clarified.
No newly painted, procedural or generated anatomical fibers, UV coordinates, normals, surface geometry or anatomical structures have been added.
ubcTexturesReplaced: UBC-derived muscle/tendon textures (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) replaced with original JIN Anatomy Studio textures; geometry and UVs unchanged.
